usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.vector_stores.search("vs_abc123", query="string", rewrite_query=False, max_num_results=10, filters={"type": "eq", "key": "string", "value": "string"}, ranking_options={"ranker": "none", "score_threshold": 0})
print(result)

typeReference.signature: client.vector_stores.search(vector_store_id, query, rewrite_query=..., max_num_results=..., filters=..., ranking_options=...) -> CursorPage[VectorStoreSearchResultItem]

fields.name: query
fields.description: A query string for a search

fields.name: rewrite_query
fields.description: Whether to rewrite the natural language query for vector search.

fields.name: max_num_results
fields.description: The maximum number of results to return. This number should be between 1 and 50 inclusive.

fields.name: filters
fields.description: A filter to apply based on file attributes.

fields.name: file_id
fields.description: The ID of the vector store file.

fields.name: filename
fields.description: The name of the vector store file.

fields.name: score
fields.description: The similarity score for the result.
